adjudication.rationale: In the newly added `apps/web/pages/api/webhook/app-credential.ts` handler, `appCredentialWebhookRequestBodySchema.parse(req.body)` is called without any `try/catch` or centralized error wrapper. In Next.js API routes, a thrown `ZodError` will result in a 500 response. There is also no `req.method` guard, so a `GET` request (where `req.body` is typically `undefined`/empty) will hit the `parse` call and throw, returning 500 instead of a 4xx. This contradicts the handler’s explicit 403/404 4xx response contract for client errors.
